light.notes: Thai basil prefers warm, bright conditions and at least six hours of direct sun. A sunny window may work; dark or cold winter windows are conditional, not equivalent to full sun.

container.notes: Sources support pot/container growing but do not establish a general volume or depth for this broad Thai-basil entry.

water.notes: Use well-drained growing medium with regular moisture checks. Small pots dry quickly; fixed watering amounts would be misleading.

establishment.notes: Establish only in warm, frost-safe conditions. The profile intentionally does not translate this into universal months.

unknowns: General minimum and preferred pot volume.
